proportions.method: Front images, manually identified shoulder-cap and helmet endpoints; 2D uncertainty approx 3px. Native bounds use foreground pixels in restricted helmet/pauldron bands. Width ratios are scale invariant; height-normalized widths distinguish head size from shoulder span.
proportions.native_measurement_note: Refined shoulder-cap landmarks isolate ceramic colors, excluding dark upper-arm silhouettes and amber uniform patches. Initial R06 broad-band estimate is retained separately. These silhouette measurements are not anatomical bone widths.

accepted_warnings: Wearable origins centered at attachment, not ground.
One enclosed hidden internal carrier in each Light and Heavy torso.
Inherited original body: 215 coincident-position vertices, 432 open boundary edges, 12 split islands; independently identical to original.
limits: Head remains stylized and large. Shoulder/neck forms more segmented than painted targets.
Actual idle legs are bent; reference stance differs.
Extreme sitting/transport poses, production equip integration and broad FPS/release checks not covered.
